_comment: The gates the TypeScript port currently registers, pinned.
The differential oracle compares the intersection of the two gate sets, so an
unported gate is never reported as a disagreement. An audit found the cost of
that: unregistering CLAIM_DISCIPLINE left `npm run differential` exiting 0. The
comparison silently halved and the harness still printed agreement, because the
only guard fired at zero cases and one gate is not zero.
So the ported set is declared here rather than inferred from the registry.
Porting a gate means adding it in two places, which is the point: a shrinking
comparison is now a deliberate, reviewable act rather than a side effect.
source_gate_count is checked against the frozen linter on every run — the number
of distinct gate ids prompt_lint.py can emit — so it cannot drift into fiction
the way the documented gate count did before SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md existed.
